t: A credit-card-sized RISC-V Linux computer for learning and small servers.
steps: Buy a VisionFive 2 Lite from a maker store such as Ameridroid or Waveshare.
Get a 5 volt, 3 amp USB-C power supply and a microSD card.
Download the Ubuntu or Debian image from the StarFive documentation site.
Write the image to the microSD card with a free flashing app.
Connect a screen, keyboard, and network cable and plug in power.
Update with apt upgrade using the allow-downgrades option StarFive suggests.
Blink an LED on the header with the libgpiod tools.
meta: Open Board. From $99.95. A few stores.
